mcq_fix.s: Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below.  List-I (Site) a. Erragudi b. Rajula Mandagiri c. Maski d. Kanaganahalli  List-II (Association) i. Portrait slab inscribed 'Ranyo Ashoka' ii. Name of Ashoka iii. Teachers asked to instil Dhamma among students iv. Evidence concerning the guru-disciple relationship

mcq_drop.why: interpretive/opinion item ('one interpretation', Puranic-term statement); not exam style

pyq_bad.why: garbled: options of other questions mixed in; no key
garbled: depends on a missing map
wrong topic: names of Buddha; suspect key: Partha is Arjuna's name

patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: 'Devanam Priya' = Ashoka, first ruler to inscribe on rocks/pillars, prisoners released on coronation anniversary, Rummindei bhaga 1/8.

Most-repeated facts across PSCs: Prinsep deciphered Brahmi, Maski/Gujarra name Ashoka, Kharosthi right-to-left at Shahbazgarhi, RE XII tolerance, RE II/XIII southern kingdoms, Firoz Shah moved Topra-Meerut pillars.
AP angle (Erragudi teachers-Dhamma, Rajula Mandagiri) is asked by APPSC; Bhattiprolu is the classic distractor.
App mirrors PYQ content well but adds deep edict numbering (RE III/VI/VIII, PE VII) and counting-type items beyond APPSC depth.
